name: JP sales call — nemawashi soft rejection
transcript:
[00:00:08] Yamamoto: Good morning Sarah. Thank you for joining today's call.
[00:00:14] Sarah: Good morning Yamamoto-san. I am excited to discuss the Q3 proposal.
[00:00:22] Yamamoto: はい、Q3のご提案について検討いたしました。内容は非常に興味深いと思いますが、少し社内で確認が必要かもしれません。
[00:00:38] Sarah: Of course. Can you share which parts need internal review?
[00:00:45] Yamamoto: 主に予算の承認と、上長への説明が必要です。前向きに検討したいと思いますが、もう少しお時間をいただけますか。
[00:01:02] Sarah: Absolutely. When do you think you will have an update for us?
[00:01:09] Yamamoto: 来週の月曜日までに内部で確認して、ご連絡いたします。担当者と相談してから判断したいと思います。
[00:01:22] Sarah: That works perfectly. I will prepare a revised budget summary and send it by Friday so you have it before your internal meeting.
[00:01:30] Yamamoto: ありがとうございます。それは非常に助かります。それでは来週ご連絡いたします。
[00:01:38] Sarah: Looking forward to it. Thank you for your time today.

summary: Yamamoto reviewed the Q3 proposal and expressed interest but needs internal budget approval.
Yamamoto will consult with superiors and respond by next Monday.
Sarah will prepare a revised budget summary and send it by Friday.

action_items.task: Prepare and send revised budget summary
Consult with superiors and provide update
